card.title: SHERWOOD FORESTERS
card.text: Deployment: Put a copy of target unit on top of owner's deck.
card.flavorText: The Sherwood Foresters Regiment was a unit of the British Army, active from 1881 to 1970, which participated in both WWI and WWII. During WWII, some of the regiment’s battalions served in the Norwegian Campaign, the Battle of France, the North African Campaign and the Italian Campaign. Others saw action in the Far East. The 1st Battalion fought in the North African and Western Desert Campaigns before remaining in the UK for the remainder of the war. The 2nd Battalion served with the 1st Infantry Division throughout the war, seeing action in France, Tunisia, and Italy. The 1/5th and 2/5th Battalions were deployed to Malaya, where they defended Singapore against the Japanese. After the fall of Singapore, many of their men became prisoners of war and were forced to work on the infamous Burma Railway. Several battalions were raised for home defense and did not see combat. A few served as anti-aircraft units, participating in the defense during the Blitz and the Battle of Britain, and later operating on the European mainland. Of the nearly 27,000 men who served in the regiment’s 17 battalions during WWII, approximately 1,500 officers and men were killed in action.
